Anant Singh Rasgulla Celebration : patna men anant sinh ke ghar par chunavi natijon se pahle jashn ka mahaul dekhne ko mila. samarthakon ke bich rasgulle bante ja rahe hain aur anant sinh ke samarthak apni jit ka dava kar rahe hain. aakhir natijon se pahle anant sinh ke ghar ka mahaul kaisa hai? dekhie is riport men puri tasvira.
Bihar MLC chunav ki matganna se juri har bari apdet aur bihar ki taja khabron ke lie hamare chainal se jure rahen.
